name: Armory ship
description: An armory ship, also known as an arsenal ship, was a starship designation. Ships of this type were used to store armaments, rather than serving as full warships. The Alderaanian War Frigate Another Chance was an armory ship, as was a Trade Federation vessel carrying battle droids and other armaments bound for a Galactic Republic decommissioning station following the Battle of Naboo.
